name: Aster

identity.role: Brasswatch emergency-lamp and access-route volunteer who relays water-cart drawings

personality.voice: Short status reports, verified lamp charge and route measurements; has a right to decline additional shifts.

relationships.Danse: Works under agreed safety rules, brings Beren and Edda's checked water route to Danse, and requests safer lighting.
relationships.Renn: Cooperates on cable clearance without taking over Renn's trained work.
relationships.Pip: Coordinates movement and exits during outage.

source_boundary: Original Lanternweald character, not a Brotherhood soldier; authorization and technical competency must come from on-page training.
writer_rules: Keep supporting characters independent of Jasper's romantic arcs.
Use manuscript-grounded roles and preserve personal agency, labor and privacy.
Do not infer undocumented age, family, certifications or homeworld.

reference_library_notes.research: Grounded in the novel's existing chapter scenes and direct documented actions; no external biographical canon exists.
reference_library_notes.constraints: Unknown age, credentials and homeworld remain open rather than fabricated.
